plan: Drive: from City of Terrace, about 57 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Beam Station Rd, Queensway Dr, Hwy 16, Eby St.
Park: 54.77194, -128.99904, pull off on Mayo Creek M/L (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 5.3 km SE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 1,018 m, about 207 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 200 m SW of the spot at 254 m (54.73271, -128.95294). Water: unnamed wetland 150 m E (estimate).
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-15, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-01, closures 2026-10-16.
R6I-duck-backcountry-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-15: about 1,861 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.21 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
